Profile.aboutPreview: Journalist and audiovisual communicator with experience in television, photography and digital communications.
Profile.aboutContinuation: She combines reporting, visual creation and content strategy from Madrid.
Profile.bio: Journalist and audiovisual communicator educated at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos. She works as a television reporter at Grupo Cadena Media, covering live events and interviews and writing the pieces that go on air.
Profile.aboutTrajectory: In parallel, she has developed a path in digital communications: the URJCmun communications team between 2022 and 2026, corporate communications and audiovisual production at Annie Bonnie, and portrait photography in tourism settings with Isocero.
Profile.interests: Professional interest in media, audiovisual production, communications and cultural projects.
